Widgets: Text
The Text widget is used to display text tied to a Board. The widget displays using rich text, so BBCode in the source text will modify how the text is displayed.
Text Reference

The Text Reference widget is used to display text that is read from a .txt file in the project. The widget displays using rich text, so BBCode in the source text will modify how the text is displayed.
Image
The Image widget is used to display an image file in the project.
Board Reference
The Board Reference widget is used to create a clickable link to open another Board.
Extension Reference
The Extension Reference widget is used to display an Extension file inside of a Board. For display only. Extensions need to be set up correctly to disable editing when being displayed in a Board.
URL
The URL widget is used to create a clickable link to open a web page.
Twine Analysis
The Twine Analysis widget is used to create a clickable link to open a Twine Analysis.
Area
The Area widget is used to label an area. Widgets within the area will be dragged with along with it.
Redirect
The Redirect widget is used to organize the connectors between widgets.
Portal
The Portal widget is used to create clickable links that will scroll the Board view to a Waypoint widget.
Waypoint
The Waypoint widget is a simple marker used by Portal widgets as scroll destinations.
Draw

The Draw widget is created by clicking the brush icon in the top right corner and then using right click on the grid. Each drawing can hold multiple lines. Drawing without a Draw widget selected will automatically create a new widget. Having a Draw widget selected will add to that widget's drawing.
